derivation_rules.landscape: From exact parent G2 identifier: main_channel/distributary/tributary/stream→river_channel; island→island; shoal/bar→shoal; floodplain→floodplain; forest→forest; ridge→ridge; backwater/wetland→backwater_wetland; river_sea→estuary; archaeological→archaeological_area; local_area→settlement_landscape; otherwise riverine_terrain.
derivation_rules.land_use: From exact approved G4 source_place_type: landing/approach/route/reach/channel/mouth/split/outflow/turn/exposed→waterway_access; forest_tract/forest_stream/pine_ridge→forest_resource_use; archaeological/burial→heritage_access_limited; vikhtuy_locality→recurrent_settlement_use; otherwise low_intensity_natural_use.
derivation_rules.function: Use exact approved G4 host catalog `source_place_type` with no normalization; family key is landscape × land_use × function.
derivation_rules.scene_template: For each family, choose the most frequent scene-template candidate among exact target canonical G5 children of G4s assigned to the tuple; deterministic tie-break by scene_template_id then version. One candidate matches current single_candidate selection rule.

seed_context.seed_context: identity fields above plus idempotency_basis equal to the exact idempotency key
seed_context.derive_seed: @rus/materialization deriveSeed(seed_context): canonicalDigest uses stableStringify then SHA-256; uint32 is the first 8 digest hex digits parsed unsigned
seed_context.initial_draw_order: candidate_ordinal 0: first draw selects committed terminal ordinal; next draw selects generated template
seed_context.continuation_draw_order: candidate_ordinal > 0: terminal ordinal comes from committed chain and is not rerolled; first draw selects generated template

semantics.through_same_exit: Generated expansion adjacency remains on the directional exit selected for this frontier; no cross-exit link is created.
semantics.existing_exit_reachable: Every generated continuation remains connected only by its existing selected directional exit, and terminal policy returns to that exact exit.
semantics.mulberry32_v1: Consumed by packages/materialization/src/spatial-v3-expansion-selection.js selectSpatialV3Expansion. Identity is {party_id, world_revision_id, g4_profile_id, g4_profile_version, expansion_slot_key: `${slot.id}@${slot.version}`, candidate_ordinal}; idempotency key is `resolve_frontier:${canonicalDigest(identity)}`; seed context is that exact identity plus idempotency_basis equal to the key. Existing deriveSeed→createRandomSource(RNG_VERSION=mulberry32_v1) supplies deterministic sampling. At ordinal 0 the first draw selects terminal ordinal then the next selects template. For later ordinals, terminal ordinal is committed and not rerolled; the first draw selects template. Request/player text and clock are excluded.

source_basis.applicability: RNG algorithm version, seed serialization and selection behavior independently approved for authoring.
